Etymology tree
Proto-Indo-European *ǵʰey-der.
Latin hībernus
Latin hībernum [tempus]ellip.
Late Latin hībernum
Old Spanish ivierno
Old Spanish in-influ.
Old Spanish invierno
Spanish invierno
Inherited from Old Spanish invierno, ivierno, from Late Latin hībernum. With an added nasal in the first syllable, and reanalyzed as in- + verno; cf. Italian inverno.
